page_title: LOR 1-2 TOU | Lorient v Toulouse 28/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Gael Angoula has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Toulouse quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+5' Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. It will be a corner kick for Toulouse.
90+3' Julien Laporte (Lorient) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the left post.
90+2' Gael Angoula blows his whistle after Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
87' Gael Angoula shows a yellow card to Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) for his blatant foul.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) replaces Mohamed Bamba.

83' 1 - 2 What a brilliant goal by Ibrahim Cissoko (Toulouse)! He collected a well-executed pass that had put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper. He took the goal-scoring opportunity with a shot to the middle of the goal past the keeper.
82' Substitution. Panos Katseris makes way for Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient).
81' Regis Le Bris has decided to make a change. Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) replaces Benjamin Mendy.
81' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) sends the corner into the box, but Guillaume Restes intercepts it and averts the threat.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ibrahim Cissoko (Toulouse) comes onto the pitch for Zakaria Aboukhlal.
78' What a big chance! Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
77' He should have scored! Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
77' 14:10 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
74' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
74' A precise cross aimed towards the penalty spot was met by Mohamed Bamba (Lorient). He outjumped the defence and produced a decent header which went a whisker wide of the right post.
72' Regis Le Bris decides to make a substitution. Imran Louza will be replaced by Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient).
72' A substitution has been made. Isaak Toure goes off and Julien Laporte (Lorient) comes on.
70' The corner is swung in but Lorient can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

70' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Guillaume Restes sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the top right corner. Lorient have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
70' Lorient work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

67' A neat pass is well received by Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
66' Good chance! Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
64' The goalkeeper dives to deny Benjamin Mendy (Lorient), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.
63' Carles Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) replacing Kevin Keben.
62' The manager makes a subsitution with Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) coming on for Aron Donnum.
62' Substitution. Stijn Spierings walks off the pitch and Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) comes on as a substitute.
61' Panos Katseris (Lorient) pings a header narrowly wide of the left post from around the penalty spot following a decent cross.
59' 1 - 1 An unlucky rebound falls to Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) and he scores with a bullet header.
59' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) latches on to a superb cross into the box and hits the right post with his header. A stroke of luck for the goalkeeper!
59' Stijn Spierings (Toulouse) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
58' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the left post!
56' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
54' Imran Louza (Lorient) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
54' Foul! Logan Costa (Toulouse) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Lorient earn a free kick.
51' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) has tested the patience of referee Gael Angoula and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
50' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Guillaume Restes, who smothers the ball.
49' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
48' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) but poses no threat.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Gabriel Suazo is replaced by Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Lorient seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' A clumsy foul by Stijn Spierings (Toulouse) and Gael Angoula blows his whistle.

43' OFF THE WOODWORK! Badredine Bouanani (Lorient) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot that smashes against the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
43' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
41' Badredine Bouanani (Lorient) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
40' Flag goes up against Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
39' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
38' Moussa Diarra (Toulouse) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
37' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Gael Angoula blows his whistle for an infringement.
33' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
31' Yellow card. Nathaniel Adjei (Lorient) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

30' Nice move, nice attempt! Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post.
28' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
25' Looks like Panos Katseris (Lorient) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
22' Poor challenge! Imran Louza (Lorient) is penalised for tripping and Gael Angoula blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Toulouse.
19' 1 - 0 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Julien Ponceau (Lorient), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 1:0.

19' Guillaume Restes pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Panos Katseris (Lorient) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the bottom right corner.
19' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the left post and flies out of play.
18' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
15' A snap shot by Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) from mid-range towards the middle of the goal catches Yvon Mvogo flat footed, but he somehow recovers and makes a brilliant save.
13' The corner by Imran Louza (Lorient) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
13' Panos Katseris (Lorient) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lorient.
11' Wonderful movement by Toulouse. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
9' Moussa Diarra (Toulouse) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
7' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Logan Costa (Toulouse) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
4' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
2' Gael Angoula blows his whistle and signals a foul after Panos Katseris (Lorient) brought his opponent down.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Toulouse will have the kick-off.
Gael Angoula will officiate today.
